meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
If your wedding-saree budget is around **₹1,500–₹3,000**, you can get something that looks quite luxe without spending heavily. I’d prioritize **Banarasi-style silk blends, organza, tissue, and embellished georgette** over very cheap “pure silk” listings—the latter are often synthetic despite the description. [thepanaya.com](https://thepanaya.com/blogs/the-panaya/best-banarasi-sarees-under-rs-5000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My best picks

### [Banarasee Handwoven Semi Silk Saree]()
*₹2,199*

### [Banarasee Handwoven Semi Silk Saree With Zari Work]()
*₹2,399*

### [Koskii Baby Pink Organza Cutwork Saree]()
*₹1,794*

### [HTLT Fashion Red Georgette Embroidered Saree]()
*₹1,899*

### [Pallu & Blouse Semi Organza Saree]()
*₹2,038*

### [Suta Kochu Pata Saree]()
*₹2,550*

**1. Banarasi/semi-silk — best overall**  
Look for deep wine, emerald, royal blue, rani pink or purple with a zari border. They photograph beautifully and look much more expensive than they are. Current examples are around **₹2,200–₹2,400**. 

**2. Organza — best for a modern, elegant wedding look**  
Pastel pink, sage/sea green, lavender or ivory with embroidery, chikankari or a zari/lace border is a great choice. Current budget options are roughly **₹1,600–₹2,200** at some sellers. [utsarees.in](https://utsarees.in/collections/organza-silk?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3. Embellished georgette — best if you want “party”**  
Choose sequins or light embroidery rather than extremely heavy stone work. Georgette is also easier to drape than stiff organza. Budget wedding options are widely available below ₹3,000. [hotdeals360.com](https://hotdeals360.com/fashion/wedding-guest-guide-elegant-ethnic-sets-and-sarees-under-3-000-10938544?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**4. Tissue — best for a rich-looking reception saree**  
Gold, champagne, copper, blush or muted pink tissue can look spectacular with a simple blouse and statement earrings. Some current options are around **₹1,600–₹2,100**. [utsarees.in](https://utsarees.in/collections/saree-under-2000?page=2&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If I were spending my own ₹2,500

- **Traditional wedding:** wine/emerald **Banarasi semi-silk + gold blouse**
- **Day wedding:** pastel blue/green **organza + delicate embroidery**
- **Reception:** champagne/blush **tissue + sequin blouse**
- **Maximum impact for ₹1,500–₹2,000:** rani pink or royal blue **Banarasi-style georgette with zari**

One important tip: **don't judge a saree by the listed “MRP” or enormous discount.** Check customer photos, fabric composition, blouse-piece details, return policy, and reviews. Marketplace listings can have very low prices but widely varying quality. [www.shopsy.in](https://www.shopsy.in/clothing-and-accessories/sarees-and-saree-essentials/sarees/georgette-chiffon~fabric/pr?sid=clo%2C8on%2Czpd&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000), age, skin tone, and whether it's a day or night wedding**, I can narrow this down to **5 specific sarees that would suit you best**.
